summary: 3-year-old girl reported missing near Coffee Pot Springs Campground north of Dotsero after wandering away from camp; search dispatched ~9:00 PM via Vail Dispatch, searchers located the girl with the GSAR K-9 team at 1:50 AM on 6/12; treated for dehydration, otherwise okay
location: Coffee Pot Springs Campground, north of Dotsero (FR 600 / 622-623)
responding_agency: Garfield County Search and Rescue, Garfield County Sheriff's Office, Eagle County Sheriff's Office (mutual aid), Classic Air Medical helicopter, US Forest Service
notes: GCSO news release 2023-06-12; reporting party texted for help from FR 600/622-623 intersection (limited cell); Classic Air night landing guided by running vehicle lights; Eagle County SO aided due to proximity to Eagle/Garfield line; mountain-lion concern noted in release; backfill run 68 (Garfield County SAR archives chunk).
